coverage: I read the gap history as it survives in the snapshots listed here. Host: validation/gaps (05-23..25), 4 git versions of super-repo gaps/gaps.json (07-25, untracked 8f8e87e7 08-02), and the operator job snapshots ~/.claude/jobs/af312d72 and 074acb94 (08-16..09-07). These job snapshots are the only surviving copies of that era's live store. Node 1: /workspace/gaps/ fossil store and backups (.bak-preclassdedup 06-13/14 at 4522 rows, .backup 07-22, .pre-halt-backup and resweep 08-30, current 830 rows still being written 09-26), the 2 truncated 08-07 temps (unparseable), the live super-repo store (6279 rows, 09-18..29), 14 orphan .tmp files (census of 2 parseable ones), auto-draft-decisions.jsonl (4506 lines), landability_predictions.log (66,866 lines, summarized), funnel-history (both series), and /workspace/parked-landings (47). Node 2: its store (70 rows). I classified themes with keyword regex, which gives rough counts. The recurrence families were built by hand from operator-filed gap ids across eras. I did not analyse audit-findings-batch.json or gap-conceptgraph.json. I did not query SurrealDB, and the advisor was unavailable (rate-limited).

problems.symptom: The gap store is reborn every 4-6 weeks and loses its history: 06-14 dedup, 07-22 restart, 08-08 path move, 09-09 97% loss, 09-18 clone rebuild (256/3548 ids survive; 0 of 264 operator gaps except test fixtures)
problems.root_cause: File-backed JSON store lives inside a git clone or an env-selected path. No durable DB-backed store and no migration on rebuild.

problems.symptom: Writers and readers of gaps/state use different WORKSPACE_ROOT/GAPS_PATH; typecheck-scenario-gen still writes typecheck_error gaps to the fossil /workspace/gaps/gaps.json (20 rows 09-11..09-26)
problems.root_cause: State addressed by env-var path with a hard-coded /workspace fallback instead of by shape

problems.symptom: Capacity or busy refusals counted as failed attempts; hopeless categories sealed; landability < 0.25 auto-close
problems.root_cause: Attempt accounting does not separate lane refusal from drafter failure. Category priors are consulted before per-gap evidence.

problems.symptom: About 78% of closes are attrition/expiry/bulk and about 6% are landed or verified, in every era (07-22..08-08: 1077/1365; 08-16..09-07: 934/1176; live: 734/937)
problems.root_cause: Closure paths do not require a land or measurement signal. The close_rate metric mixes telemetry and administrative closes.

problems.symptom: recommit-/-narrowed children grow 17 → 104 → 433 → 746 and close at about 4%
problems.root_cause: A failed compose forks a new gap id instead of enriching the parent

problems.symptom: Fixed set of test-probe gaps written into every live store on both nodes, plus the attempt-ledger canary in parked landings
problems.root_cause: The test suite inherits live WORKSPACE_ROOT and endpoints; no hermetic default

problems.symptom: Detector or auto-mint floods: 4522 in 2 days in June, 1724/day on 09-20, 763 missing_capability of which 734 had single-goal demand
problems.root_cause: No demand or admission check at filing time; cleanup is always a manual bulk close

problems.symptom: Uninterpolated {{template}} placeholders stored as gap status/source (23 live); a TypeScript code block written as line 1 of the funnel-history data file
problems.root_cause: The gap write path accepts LLM output without schema or placeholder validation. The 09-05 gap filing this was lost at the reset.

problems.symptom: A stale-base cutover silently reverts a landed commit
problems.root_cause: Retried or coalesced compose reuses a base captured before the prior landing

problems.symptom: Restart or drain kills in-flight compose or dispatches
problems.root_cause: Restart and quiesce do not count all in-flight lanes. Filed, rejected, then re-filed after the reset.

problems.symptom: Behaviour steered by env vars (authoring emit, concept-db upkeep, trace retention, compose lane cap, GAPS_PATH, PARKED_LANDINGS_DIR)
problems.root_cause: Bootstrap config used for runtime behaviour, against law 1

problems.symptom: Inert or vacuous landings pass the gate; the vacuous guard then over-refuses
problems.root_cause: The gate reads the diff, not the consuming reader or effect

problems.symptom: Write-only logs: landability_predictions.log (10.5MB/3d), auto-draft-decisions.jsonl (1MB/7d); funnel median_latency_ms=0 and expired=0 on all 47 live runs
problems.root_cause: Instrumentation added without a reader activity. The lifecycle expiry path is dormant on the live store.

problems.symptom: Same remedy re-dispatched forever: 'reconcile the trace store back under its configured cap' decided 518 times 09-24..28
problems.root_cause: No failure memory or backoff on the auto-draft remedy path

problems.symptom: Orphan gaps.json.*.tmp files (~98MB live dir, ~300MB on 09-10), fossil /workspace/gaps store, stale validation/gaps narration dir
problems.root_cause: Atomic write whose rename fails leaves a temp file; nothing reaps them

problems.symptom: 25 of 47 verified parked patches target human-surface proxy.ts and can never land
problems.root_cause: human-surface-vessel has no gitlink or push clone (unauthorable). The park has no exit or escalation for it.

principles: A gap store reborn every 4-6 weeks cannot measure durability; losing it erases the recurrence evidence that would falsify a 'newly resolved' claim.
State addressed by an env-var path with a hard-coded fallback forks silently whenever the path moves; address stores by shape. This shard found seven hats of the WORKSPACE_ROOT split.
A log with no reader is disk growth, not instrumentation; every new log needs a named reader activity at creation.
A retry that mints a new gap id defeats id-based dedup, recurrence counting and closure credit; enrich the parent instead.
Split every close-rate by basis. About 78% attrition and about 6% landed or verified held in all three eras, while the headline close_rate of 0.57-0.75 was mostly telemetry and administrative closes.
Category-level priors (hopeless, calibration, landability) must never bury an individual gap without per-gap evidence. Declared fixed three times; recurred every time.
Separate 'the lane refused' from 'the attempt failed' at a single accounting seam.
Tests must be hermetic by default; otherwise fixtures land in every live store on every node.
Detector or auto-mint output needs admission control (demand of 2+ goals, dedup by family) at filing time, or the operator bulk-closes by hand every era.
